question: The line graph that can replace a histogram is called a/an:

options.text: cumulative frequency less than type graph
cumulative frequency more than type graph

solution:
The line graph that can replace a histogram is called a __**frequency polygon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Frequency Polygon:** A frequency polygon is a graph constructed by using lines to join the midpoints of each interval or bin. The heights of the points represent the frequencies. A frequency polygon can be created from the histogram or by calculating the midpoints of the bins from the frequency distribution table.
